customCss: :root { --light-bg: #f8fafc; --dark-bg: #0f172a; --light-content-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); --dark-content-bg: rgba(15,23,42,0.9); } [data-color-mode="light"] body { background-image: url('https://haowallpaper.com/link/common/file/previewFileImg/15758358777205056') !important; background-size: cover !important; background-attachment: fixed !important; background-position: center !important; background-blend-mode: overlay !important; background-color: var(--light-bg) !important; } [data-color-mode="dark"] body { background-image: url('https://haowallpaper.com/link/common/file/previewFileImg/15758358777205056') !important; background-size: cover !important; background-attachment: fixed !important; background-position: center !important; background-blend-mode: overlay !important; background-color: var(--dark-bg) !important; } #content, #header, #footer { backdrop-filter: blur(8px) !important; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) !important; background-color: var(--light-content-bg) !important; border-radius: 12px !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) !important; } [data-color-mode="dark"] #content, [data-color-mode="dark"] #header, [data-color-mode="dark"] #footer { background-color: var(--dark-content-bg) !important; } .SideNav-item { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85) !important; } [data-color-mode="dark"] .SideNav-item { background-color: rgba(30,41,59,0.85) !important; } #content > div:first-child { background-color: rgba(241,245,249,0.8) !important; } [data-color-mode="dark"] #content > div:first-child { background-color: rgba(30,41,59,0.8) !important; }
